Supervision trigger conditions are: the same complaint has been transferred 2 times and remains unresolved, or a safety hazard is involved and personal injury may result, or the same type of issue in the same district has been repeatedly reported 3 or more times within the last 30 days; if none of the three is met, it is handled as a routine transfer.
